purpose: Correlate confirmed COLI0200 material IDs with the canonical per-contact surfaceMask path and modern DD-wheel output.

samplePolicy.recommended: emit on any surfaceMask/loadColiType/stage/roadSection change; optional <=10Hz heartbeat
samplePolicy.reason: Preserves transitions without per-frame log volume.

fields.name: surfaceMask
fields.semantic: four native contact surface masks; canonical EXE proves each mask is 1u << COLI0200 materialId

fields.name: contactCollisionIndex
fields.semantic: exact COLI polygon selected for each native contact

fields.name: materialId
fields.source: derived from one-hot surfaceMask[i] using countr_zero/bit-scan
fields.semantic: exact COLI0200 material byte for nonzero one-hot masks; canonical EXE VA 0x0043ECB8..0x0043ECC7

derived.name: materialTransition
derived.formula: surfaceMask[i] or materialId[i] changed since prior sample

wheelOrder.source: 0x46BBF0 per-car geometry table copied by 0x4A58EC into EVWORK_CAR::vector_130[0..3]
wheelOrder.finalLabels: OPEN; do not assign FL/FR/RL/RR until forward-axis convention is independently proven

interpretationRules: Canonical EXE proves surfaceMask = 1u << materialId for the selected collision record.
Use contactCollisionIndex as the primary static/runtime join key when available.
Raw vehicle position alone cannot index the COLI 256x256 grid without reproducing the collision-set-local transform.
Contact local topology is known, but FL/FR/RL/RR human labels remain open.
Section8 values are lighting/intensity coefficients and must not be used as FFB material identity.
Human labels for non-primary material IDs remain open until effect/runtime correlation identifies the physical surface.
successCriteria: On Snowy Mountain, roadSection 132-203 should report ordinary material 0x01/mask 0x2 rather than snow material 0x17/mask 0x800000.
On Ice Scape, primary road sections 0-620 should report material 0x17/mask 0x800000.
Deep Lake roadSection 419-458 should report material 0x14/mask 0x100000; reverse 218-257 likewise.
Exact contactCollisionIndex must resolve to a static record whose materialId reproduces the runtime surfaceMask.
No FL/FR/RL/RR label is promoted until contact forward-axis orientation is proven.

primaryKnown.0x14: special rough primary-road strip; mask 0x00100000; native roughness 0.71
primaryKnown.0x16: Casino Town primary-road family; mask 0x00400000; Casino exception roughness 0.25
primaryKnown.0x17: Snow/Ice primary road; mask 0x00800000; native roughness 0.50
